filter_artifact_evidence: For iid controls, median horizontal/vertical correlation of raw-minus-Gaussian1 residual is -0.17219/-0.17223 although injected noise is independent. Actual raw residual medians -0.10319/-0.10418. Highpass/filter residual correlation alone cannot diagnose observation-noise dependence.
engineering_threshold_caveat: 18/24 coverage and HH excess .05 in>=6 images are fixed practical safeguards, not calibrated significance or scientifically universal thresholds. Low-noise cells have0/8 qualifyingimages, middle4/8, high8/8; stopping reflectslimiteduniform-region identifiability, not proof a blindspotCNN cannothelp.
